_schema: Run 31 Phase 1 merge-brainstorm constructs. Each = a merge of maximally distant REAL concepts (parents trace to real sourced bank entries). Generated by 6 Opus agents, NO search (R7: search is only P3 anti-cheating / P5 niche-value).

constructs.merged_construct: Hysteretic LoRA: Domain-Pinned Adapter Routing with Coercive-Field Switching
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: LoRA is a parameter-efficient fine-tuning trick (systems/optimization); ferromagnetic hysteresis is a condensed-matter physics phenomenon of domain pinning and a B-H loop; bacterial chemotaxis is a microbiology gradient-sensing behavior. A fine-tuning method, a magnetism loop, and flagellar swimming live in three unrelated literatures and would never be cited together.
constructs.mechanism: Replace the single static low-rank delta DeltaW = BA with a stateful, hysteretic adapter whose effective rank-r direction is governed by a magnetization-like internal state m in [-1,1] per adapter that lags the input-domain signal. Define a 'domain field' h(x) as the chemotaxis-style temporal derivative of a domain embedding (compare the domain-classifier readout at consecutive tokens, exactly as chemotaxis compares receptor occupancy across time rather than reading an absolute gradient). The adapter state updates m_{t+1} = clip(m_t + sign(h - h_pin) * eta) only when |h - h_pin| exceeds a coercive threshold h_c, so small fluctuations cannot flip the adapter (pinning), while sustained drift across domains snaps it to a new branch. The applied delta is BA scaled by a smooth function of m, giving two stable adapter regimes (a B-H-loop with two coercive points) that resist thrashing under noisy, mixed-domain streams. The new capability is a continually-adapting LoRA that remembers which domain it is in, exhibits stick-slip switching at task boundaries (loop area = adaptation energy spent), and is provably robust to high-frequency domain noise because flipping requires crossing the coercive field.

constructs.merged_construct: Critical-Mass MoE: Neutron-Economy Routing with Subcritical Reflectors
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Sparse MoE routing is an architecture/efficiency technique; nuclear fission chain-reaction control (multiplication factor k, critical mass, neutron reflectors) is reactor physics; MacArthur-Wilson island biogeography (immigration-extinction equilibrium controlling species richness) is ecology. A router, a reactor, and an island ecosystem share no natural research overlap.
constructs.mechanism: Reframe expert activation as a controlled chain reaction: each routed token is a 'neutron' that, when it activates an expert, can spawn additional expert activations (secondary routing) with a per-expert multiplication factor k_e learned from gradient utility. Import the reactor control law: maintain the effective multiplication factor k_eff = sum_e p_e * k_e at exactly 1 (delayed-critical) by adjusting a global 'control-rod' temperature on the router softmax, so compute neither dies out (k<1, underuse) nor explodes (k>1, runaway activation). Borrow island biogeography for the expert pool itself: treat each expert's 'species richness' (distinct token-types it serves) as an immigration-extinction balance, applying a usage-decay (extinction) term and a novelty-driven reassignment (immigration) term so the per-expert effective capacity self-equilibrates to the MacArthur-Wilson fixed point. Underused experts are placed near 'reflectors' (high-affinity router neighbors) that bounce tokens back to keep them subcritical-but-alive rather than collapsing load. The result is an MoE whose total activated FLOPs are homeostatically pinned (k_eff=1) and whose expert specialization spectrum self-stabilizes without an auxiliary load-balancing loss, eliminating both dead experts and activation blowups.

constructs.merged_construct: Quorum-Gated Speculative Decoding with Allosteric Acceptance
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Speculative decoding is an LLM inference-acceleration trick; bacterial quorum sensing (autoinducer density crossing a threshold to switch collective behavior) is microbiology; allosteric enzyme regulation (an effector at a remote site changing catalytic conformation) is biochemistry. An autoregressive sampler, a population density switch, and an enzyme's conformational change occupy entirely disjoint domains.
constructs.mechanism: Replace per-token rejection sampling with a population-level, density-triggered commit. Run a swarm of K cheap draft heads that each emit a candidate continuation; treat each draft head as a bacterium secreting an 'autoinducer' equal to its token-level confidence, and accumulate a local autoinducer concentration A = sum of agreeing-draft confidences over a sliding window. The expensive target model is invoked only when A crosses a quorum threshold, at which point it verifies the whole agreed block in one parallel pass (large blocks committed when drafts are densely confident, single tokens when sparse). Layer an allosteric acceptance rule on top of the target's verification head: a remote 'regulatory' signal (e.g., running KL between draft and target distributions over recent context) binds an allosteric site that smoothly shifts the acceptance-probability conformation between a permissive state (high speculative depth) and a restrictive state (near-greedy verification), implementing feedback inhibition when drafts drift. This yields adaptive, content-dependent speculation length with provably unbiased samples, far larger average accepted blocks in agreement-rich regions, and automatic throttling when the draft ensemble disagrees.

constructs.merged_construct: Morphogen-Positional RoPE: Diffusion-Gradient Coordinates for Sequence Position
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: RoPE is a positional-encoding mechanism in transformer architecture; morphogen gradients (French-flag positional information set by diffusion from a source) are developmental biology; Hox genes (collinear combinatorial body-axis identity from a gene cluster) are evolutionary-developmental genetics. A rotation-of-query-keys scheme, a diffusing chemical gradient, and a body-plan gene cluster share no natural literature.
constructs.mechanism: Swap RoPE's fixed angular schedule (theta_i fixed geometric per dimension) for a learned morphogen field: emit a small set of 'source' tokens whose activations act as morphogen sources, and let a cheap diffusion operator (a fixed low-pass / heat-kernel pass over the sequence) produce a smooth concentration profile c(pos) for each of several morphogen channels. Each token's positional code is the vector of local morphogen concentrations, and the per-dimension RoPE rotation angle is set as a monotone readout of c(pos) rather than a fixed function of integer index, so positions are encoded by where a token sits in a diffused field (robust to insertions/deletions and to length extrapolation, since concentration interpolates). Add Hox-style combinatorial collinearity: discretize concentrations into ordered threshold bands so that contiguous spans inherit a shared 'segment identity' token-tag, giving the model an explicit, ordered region structure (chapter/clause/segment) emergent from thresholds on the gradient. The new capability is position encoding that bends gracefully under edits and long contexts and that exposes a discrete hierarchical segmentation as a free byproduct of the morphogen thresholds.

constructs.merged_construct: Le Chatelier RLHF: Equilibrium-Restoring KL Control under Reward Stress
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: PPO for RLHF is a policy-gradient/alignment method; Le Chatelier's principle (a chemical equilibrium shifting to counteract an applied stress) is physical chemistry; physiological negative feedback (homeostatic set-point regulation by sensor-effector loops) is mammalian physiology. A clipped policy objective, a reaction-equilibrium law, and a hormonal thermostat have no shared venue.
constructs.mechanism: Treat the policy-versus-reference distribution as a chemical equilibrium 'reaction' whose position is measured by the KL divergence acting as a reaction quotient Q, and treat the reward gradient as an applied stress. Import Le Chatelier explicitly: the effective KL penalty coefficient beta is not fixed nor merely adapted toward a target KL, but is computed as a counteracting force proportional to the *rate of change* of Q under the current reward push (d KL/d step), so that whenever reward optimization rapidly displaces the equilibrium, the penalty rises to partially restore it, and relaxes when the push subsides. Wrap this in a physiological negative-feedback loop with an explicit set-point KL* and both proportional and integral terms (sensor = measured KL, effector = beta and the clip range epsilon), giving homeostatic regulation rather than the brittle fixed-clip of standard PPO. Reward-model over-optimization (Goodharting) is interpreted as the equilibrium being driven into an unphysical region; the integral term accumulates and clamps it. The result is RLHF whose distributional drift is self-limiting and self-restoring, reducing reward hacking without a hand-tuned KL schedule and with provable bounded steady-state KL error.

constructs.merged_construct: Activation-Energy Dropout: Arrhenius-Thresholded Stochastic Gating
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Dropout is a neural-network regularizer; the Arrhenius equation and collision-theory chemical kinetics (rate = A*exp(-Ea/RT), with an activation-energy barrier and a temperature-controlled Boltzmann tail) are physical chemistry. A coin-flip masking scheme and a reaction-rate law over molecular collisions belong to unrelated fields.
constructs.mechanism: Replace dropout's uniform Bernoulli retention probability p with a per-unit, magnitude-dependent survival probability drawn from an Arrhenius law: a unit is 'dropped' (deactivated) only if it fails to clear an activation-energy barrier Ea_j, with retention probability p_j = exp(-Ea_j / (k * T)), where the 'temperature' T is a global schedule (high T early in training = nearly all units active, cooling T late = aggressive selective pruning, mirroring an annealing reaction). Set each unit's barrier from its recent contribution (e.g., Ea_j inversely related to the running magnitude of its gradient*activation), so low-utility units sit high on the barrier and are preferentially knocked out, exactly as only sufficiently energetic collisions react. This mirrors the chemical-kinetics failure mode in reverse: instead of noise destroying signal, the Boltzmann tail of the gating preserves only the 'reactive' (useful) units. Forward pass and straight-through gradients otherwise follow standard dropout. The capability gained is a unified regularize-then-prune mechanism: a single temperature knob smoothly interpolates from dense regularized training to a sparsified subnetwork, with the Arrhenius form giving an interpretable, schedulable selectivity and a smoother accuracy-sparsity frontier than fixed-rate dropout.

constructs.merged_construct: Cooper-Pair Optimizer: Phonon-Mediated Gradient Pairing for Loss-less Descent
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Adam is a first-order adaptive optimizer; BCS superconductivity (electrons binding into Cooper pairs via phonon exchange and condensing into a single coherent ground state below T_c) and driven-oscillator resonance (energy transfer maximal at the natural frequency, sharpness set by quality factor Q) are condensed-matter and classical physics. An optimizer update rule, a paired-electron condensate, and a resonance peak do not co-occur.
constructs.mechanism: Augment Adam by pairing parameters whose gradients are persistently anti-correlated (the 'phonon-mediated attraction'): maintain a running cross-correlation between coordinate gradients and form Cooper-like pairs (i,j) with strong negative correlation. For each pair, descend on a coherent paired coordinate (g_i - g_j)/sqrt(2) with a shared, condensate-style adaptive second moment, so paired updates move in lockstep through the loss landscape with reduced scattering off curvature roughness (lower effective gradient noise = 'loss-less' transport of the optimization current). Introduce a temperature-like noise scale that, below a critical value T_c (late training / small batch noise), triggers a condensation: a large fraction of coordinates lock into the coherent ground-state direction and the optimizer takes long, low-resistance steps. Use resonance to set per-coordinate learning rates: estimate each coordinate's natural oscillation frequency from the sign-flip rate of its gradient and tune its step so the update is driven near that frequency with a controlled quality factor Q, maximizing energy transfer (progress) while avoiding the high-Q divergence. The new capability is an optimizer that adaptively bundles correlated directions into coherent macro-steps in flat/noisy regimes and resonantly tunes per-direction rates, improving late-stage convergence stability on ill-conditioned objectives.

constructs.merged_construct: Endosymbiotic Distillation: Engulf-and-Retain Teacher Organelles
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Knowledge distillation is a model-compression method; endosymbiotic theory (a host cell engulfing a bacterium that persists as a mitochondrion, gradually transferring genes to the host nucleus) and horizontal gene transfer (conjugation/transformation moving genetic material laterally between organisms) are cell and molecular biology. A teacher-student KL loss, the origin of organelles, and bacterial gene swapping share no natural literature.
constructs.mechanism: Instead of distilling a teacher into a student only via soft-label matching, the student 'engulfs' the teacher as a retained, initially-frozen sub-module (an 'organelle') wired in through lightweight cross-attention ports, mirroring endocytic retention. Training proceeds in a symbiogenesis schedule: phase 1, the organelle is queried as a coprocessor and the student learns to route hard inputs to it (host depends on organelle for energy); phase 2, a horizontal-gene-transfer step periodically copies the most-used organelle weight-blocks (selected by attribution/usage) into the host network via low-rank grafts, and the corresponding organelle blocks are then deleted, exactly as endosymbiont genes migrate to the nucleus and the organelle genome shrinks. A retention pressure (a small reconstruction loss against the organelle's outputs) prevents catastrophic loss during transfer. Over training the organelle is progressively absorbed until only an essential minimal core remains (like the residual mitochondrial genome), and the host alone matches teacher behavior. The capability gained is staged, attribution-guided compression that transfers capability block-by-block rather than globally, yielding a small standalone student plus an interpretable trace of which teacher modules were internalized.

constructs.merged_construct: Telomere Budget: Replication-Countdown Capping for KV-Cache and Reasoning Depth

parents.name: Agent Memory Below the Prompt (Persistent Q4 KV Cache)

constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Persistent quantized KV-cache for edge agents is a systems/inference-efficiency technique; telomeres (repetitive chromosome end-caps that shorten each division, enforcing the Hayflick limit) and apoptosis (programmed cell death via caspase cascades when stress thresholds are crossed) are molecular cell biology. A disk-backed attention cache, a chromosome-shortening clock, and programmed cell death do not co-occur in research.
constructs.mechanism: Attach a telomere-like consumable counter to each persisted KV-cache segment (and, in a reasoning agent, to each spawned thought-branch): every reuse/replication of a cache block 'shortens its telomere' by a fixed amount, and blocks may extend their counter only by passing a 'telomerase' test (a relevance/utility check that re-activates frequently-hit, high-value context). Blocks whose telomere reaches zero are retired, bounding unchecked cache growth and staleness on edge devices with a principled, age-and-use-aware eviction policy instead of pure recency. Couple this to an apoptosis controller: when a reasoning branch accumulates 'damage signals' (rising self-consistency entropy, contradiction with verified facts, or repeated tool failures) past a caspase-like threshold, the branch triggers programmed termination and its KV segment is reclaimed, preventing runaway low-value rollouts from exhausting the persistent store. Healthy branches that clear the checkpoint are spared. The new capability is a self-limiting agent memory and search process whose footprint and depth are governed by biological-style replication budgets and damage-triggered pruning, giving bounded memory, automatic removal of degenerate reasoning paths, and graceful long-horizon operation under tight edge constraints.

constructs.merged_construct: Surface-Tension Attention: Minimal-Area Token Films with Capillary Sparsity
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Sparse/windowed attention is an efficient-transformer method; surface tension (cohesive forces minimizing liquid interfacial area, forming menisci and films) is fluid physics; osmosis (water crossing a semipermeable membrane down a solute-potential gradient until pressures balance) is physiology/biophysics. A sparse attention mask, a soap-film energy, and membrane water transport occupy unrelated domains.
constructs.mechanism: Replace Longformer's hand-fixed sliding-window-plus-global mask with a learned, energy-minimizing sparse connectivity that behaves like a liquid film: define an interfacial-energy functional over the binary attention graph equal to (surface-tension coefficient gamma) times the number of active long-range 'bridges' plus a content term that lowers energy where token-pair affinity is high, and relax the mask toward minimal 'surface area' so connections coalesce into compact clusters and thin necks (menisci) only where semantically necessary, automatically discovering document structure instead of imposing a fixed window. Add an osmotic balance to set how much attention 'flux' crosses cluster boundaries: treat each cluster as a compartment separated by a semipermeable membrane, and allow inter-cluster attention mass to flow down a 'concentration' gradient (difference in unmet query demand) until an osmotic-pressure equilibrium is reached, capping cross-cluster bandwidth adaptively rather than via a fixed number of global tokens. Training uses a straight-through relaxation of the mask with the interfacial energy as a regularizer. The capability gained is input-adaptive structured sparsity that matches true long-range structure (forming the minimal set of bridges) while bounding cross-region communication by a principled osmotic equilibrium, improving the quality-compute tradeoff over fixed sparse patterns.

constructs.merged_construct: Somatic-Hypermutation Best-of-N: Affinity-Maturation Sampling with Clonal Selection

parents.name: Best-of-N Sampling (Inference-Time Scaling via Rejection Sampling)

constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Best-of-N inference-time sampling is an LLM test-time-compute method; somatic hypermutation (AID-driven targeted mutation of antibody variable regions at rates 10^5-fold above baseline) and clonal selection (antigen-driven proliferation of the highest-affinity B-cell clones in germinal centers) are immunology. A reward-ranked sampler, targeted antibody mutation, and germinal-center B-cell selection share no natural research overlap.
constructs.mechanism: Turn flat best-of-N into an iterative affinity-maturation loop. Round 1: sample N candidate responses (the naive B-cell repertoire) and score them with a reward model/verifier (antigen affinity). Apply clonal selection: keep the top-k highest-affinity candidates and 'clonally expand' them by allocating more of next round's budget to their lineages in proportion to reward, exactly as high-affinity clones proliferate. Apply somatic hypermutation with targeting: rather than resampling whole responses, introduce a high local mutation rate only in the spans most responsible for affinity gain or loss (identified via token-level reward attribution or self-critique), echoing AID's targeting of the variable region's complementarity-determining hotspots while leaving the framework regions conserved. Iterate selection-then-hypermutation for several germinal-center 'cycles', with the mutation temperature decaying as affinity plateaus. The result is a test-time search that concentrates compute on promising lineages and edits precisely the decisive spans, achieving higher final reward at equal total samples than independent best-of-N, plus a record of which response regions drove the improvement.

constructs.merged_construct: Baroreflex Learning-Rate Control with Isostatic Slow-Rebound
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Cardiovascular reflex arc (carotid-sinus stretch -> autonomic outflow) and viscoelastic crustal relaxation after ice unloading are textbook examples from cardiology and geophysics with zero literature overlap with adaptive gradient optimizers; neither would be reached by an optimization researcher.
constructs.mechanism: Replace Adam's fixed scalar learning rate with a baroreflex set-point controller acting on the gradient-noise 'pressure' p_t = ||g_t||^2 / v_t (squared gradient over Adam's second moment). A fast afferent branch maps deviations p_t - p* into an immediate multiplicative correction on the step size eta_t <- eta_t * sigma(-k_baro (p_t - p*)), mimicking the sympathetic/parasympathetic push-pull that buffers blood pressure within heartbeats. Superposed is a slow isostatic-rebound channel: a second-order viscoelastic state r_t relaxes the set-point itself toward the long-run mean pressure with a Maxwell-body time constant tau >> 1, r_{t+1} = r_t + (1/tau)(EMA(p_t) - r_t), so p* = p*_0 + alpha r_t drifts only after sustained load changes (e.g., entering a sharp loss basin). The fast loop suppresses per-step instability while the slow loop prevents permanent over-damping, giving an optimizer that both reacts to acute gradient spikes and structurally 'rebounds' its aggressiveness once a difficult region is passed. New capability: automatic two-timescale step-size homeostasis without manual warmup/decay schedules.

constructs.merged_construct: Coagulation-Cascade Sparse Attention with Thermohaline Gating
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: The zymogen amplification cascade of hemostasis and density-driven deep-ocean overturning are a hematology mechanism and an oceanography mechanism respectively; neither shares vocabulary or venues with efficient-attention research on long-context transformers.
constructs.mechanism: Transfer the clotting cascade's localized threshold-amplification onto sparse attention's connectivity. Each token holds an inactive 'zymogen' attention budget; a token is converted to an 'active protease' (allowed to densify its attention beyond the sliding window) only when local injury — a high local attention-score variance exceeding tissue-factor threshold theta — is detected, after which it recruits a bounded set of neighbors via factor-VIIa-like propagation, producing a self-limiting clot of dense attention exactly where the sequence is 'damaged' (information-dense). To prevent runaway clotting, a thermohaline gate borrows density-driven overturning: per-head we compute a 'water-mass density' from token salinity (norm) and temperature (entropy); heads where activated regions become too dense sink and are overturned — their dense edges are flushed back to sparse, recirculating capacity to cooler surface tokens. Update each step: activation indicator a_i = 1[var_local(i) > theta] with refractory antithrombin decay; overturning flux moves a fraction of the dense-edge budget from high-density to low-density tokens. New capability: input-adaptive, self-terminating dense-attention bursts with global capacity conservation, achieving near-full-attention quality on the rare critical spans at sparse-attention cost.

constructs.merged_construct: Immunological-Memory Replay Buffer with Orbital-Resonance Rehearsal Scheduling
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Antigen-specific memory-cell persistence and integer-ratio mean-motion resonances between orbiting bodies come from immunology and celestial mechanics; a model-based RL practitioner has no reason to connect either to world-model replay.
constructs.mechanism: Augment DreamerV3's experience replay with an immune-memory tier: rare, high-surprise transitions (large world-model prediction error = 'antigen') trigger clonal expansion, spawning a long-lived memory clone whose retention half-life scales with how strongly it was reactivated, and whose imagined-rollout sampling weight is boosted on any future re-encounter (secondary response = faster, larger), implementing affinity-matured prioritization beyond simple TD-error priority. The rehearsal schedule is set by orbital resonance: each memory clone is assigned a replay 'period' and clones are nudged into small-integer period ratios (1:2, 2:3) so that distinct memories receive periodic, phase-locked reinforcement kicks that constructively reinforce rather than randomly collide, while clones that drift into resonance overlap (would alias) are gravitationally scattered to new periods to keep coverage uniform. Update: retention r <- r + eta*reactivation; periods evolve by a resonance-locking term that minimizes phase error to the nearest rational ratio. New capability: catastrophic-forgetting-resistant world models with structured, non-aliasing rehearsal of rare events.

constructs.merged_construct: RAAS Cascade Reward Renormalization for Over-Optimization Control

parents.name: Reward Model Ensembles for Overoptimization Mitigation

constructs.cognitive_distance_note: The renal hormonal cascade regulating blood volume and buoyancy-driven solid-state mantle overturn are a renal-physiology system and a geodynamics system; neither is invoked in RLHF reward-modeling work on over-optimization.
constructs.mechanism: Import RAAS's multi-stage gain-controlled cascade to regulate effective reward 'pressure' during policy optimization. The ensemble's reward disagreement acts as 'renal perfusion': when disagreement rises (proxy reward becoming unreliable, analogous to falling renal blood flow), juxtaglomerular-like sensors secrete 'renin', triggering a cascade (renin -> angiotensin I -> II) that multiplicatively contracts the trusted reward signal and, via an 'aldosterone' slow arm, raises a KL penalty 'salt-and-water retention' that conserves proximity to the reference policy. The cascade's two-stage fast/slow structure decouples acute clamps from sustained tightening. Mantle convection supplies the long-timescale mixing law for the ensemble itself: reward-model members are treated as thermal cells; hot (high-loss, stale) members buoyantly upwell and are retrained/replaced while cold well-calibrated members downwell, giving continuous slow turnover that prevents the whole ensemble from collectively drifting toward the policy's exploited region. Update: penalty_t = penalty_0 * f_angiotensin(disagreement_t) + aldosterone_slow_EMA; member turnover driven by a Rayleigh-number-like instability criterion on per-member loss. New capability: homeostatic, self-stabilizing reward signal that resists Goodharting without a hand-tuned KL coefficient.

constructs.merged_construct: Frank-Starling Preload Gating for Mixture-of-Experts Capacity
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: The heart's length-tension autoregulation (greater filling -> greater stroke output) and the tropical Hadley overturning cell are cardiac physiology and climatology; sparse-MoE routing literature never references either.
constructs.mechanism: Replace Switch Transformer's hard capacity factor with a Frank-Starling preload law per expert: an expert's effective compute output (its per-token gain) rises with its incoming token 'venous return' (assigned load) along a length-tension curve, so a transiently popular expert stretches and contracts harder (allocates more FLOPs/larger effective rank) up to a Starling plateau, after which further filling causes decompensation and the router sheds load — giving graceful, biologically-shaped overflow instead of a sharp drop. The Hadley cell provides the global redistribution circulation that closes the loop: tokens 'rise' at over-subscribed experts (the ITCZ), are transported aloft to under-utilized experts (descending subtropical branch) via an auxiliary meridional routing flow, and return along the surface, so the auxiliary balance loss is realized as a physical conserved circulation rather than a penalty term. Update: expert gain g_e = Starling(load_e) with refractory plateau; routing logits add a circulation potential that advects excess tokens down the utilization gradient. New capability: load-adaptive per-expert compute and self-balancing routing that maintains throughput under bursty token distributions.

constructs.merged_construct: Complement-Cascade Opsonization for Speculative-Decoding Verification
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: The complement protein cascade (opsonization, membrane-attack amplification) and seismic-wave traveltime inversion belong to immunology and geophysics; speculative decoding for LLM inference shares neither.
constructs.mechanism: Recast speculative decoding's accept/reject as a complement cascade. The draft model proposes K tokens; rather than a single rejection test, a sequential proteolytic cascade tags ('opsonizes') each draft token with escalating confidence fragments (C3b-like deposits) accumulated from cheap intermediate target-model signals (early-exit logits at successive layers), and a token is 'accepted' only once deposited confidence crosses a membrane-attack threshold, otherwise it is marked for phagocytic resampling. Amplification means one strongly-supported early token lowers the threshold for its successors (cascade gain), accepting long correct runs quickly. Seismology supplies a traveltime model that decides WHERE to spend full target-model passes: treating layer-wise logit changes as wavefronts, we invert for the 'hypocenter' depth at which the draft and target first diverge (analogous to locating an earthquake from P/S arrivals), and run the expensive full verification only from that depth onward, skipping shallow layers that already agree. Update: deposit c_i <- c_i + early_signal; accept when c_i > theta_MAC with neighbor-coupled threshold decay; verification depth = argmin of inverted divergence traveltime. New capability: graded, amplification-driven acceptance with depth-targeted verification, raising token acceptance length at lower verification FLOPs.

constructs.merged_construct: Herd-Immunity Dropout with Seafloor-Spreading Capacity Accretion
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: The epidemiological herd-immunity threshold (1 - 1/R0) and mid-ocean-ridge crustal accretion are epidemiology and geology; standard regularization research on dropout draws on neither, and inverting dropout into a transmission-blocking constraint is non-obvious.
constructs.mechanism: Invert dropout's constraint: instead of dropping units to prevent co-adaptation, treat over-reliance on a feature as a contagious pathogen and drop precisely enough units to push the network above a herd-immunity threshold that blocks 'transmission' of a single fragile feature through the layer. Each unit has an estimated reproduction number R0_i = expected number of downstream units whose activation collapses if unit i is corrupted (measured via a cheap perturbation probe); the per-layer keep-rate is set adaptively so the immune fraction exceeds 1 - 1/max_i R0_i, guaranteeing no single feature can drive a cascade of co-dependent activations — robustness as epidemic control rather than random masking. Seafloor spreading governs capacity growth: at a central 'ridge' (the most plastic layer) new units are accreted symmetrically over training and conveyed outward, aging as they migrate so older units become rigid (frozen) crust while fresh units near the ridge stay plastic, yielding a striped age structure that paces representational turnover. Update: keep_rate_l <- 1 - 1/R0_hat_l(t); new-unit spawn rate at ridge with magnetic-stripe-like freeze schedule by distance from ridge. New capability: targeted anti-fragility (provable block of single-feature cascade failure) plus controlled lifelong capacity expansion.

constructs.merged_construct: Thermoregulatory Set-Point Temperature for Diffusion Sampling under Mantle-Plume Bursts
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Hypothalamic thermostatic control of body temperature and buoyant thermal-diapir plumes detaching from the core-mantle boundary are physiology and geodynamics; DDPM noise scheduling is unrelated to either.
constructs.mechanism: Import hypothalamic thermoregulation to make the diffusion sampler's effective temperature a regulated variable rather than a fixed schedule. A 'thermostat' tracks a proxy core temperature T_core (e.g., running estimate of score-field disagreement / local entropy of the denoiser) against a set-point; when sampling is 'overheating' (high-variance, mode-mixing region) the controller triggers heat-loss effectors — vasodilation/sweating analogues that raise the guidance strength and shrink the step (cooling toward the data manifold); when 'too cold' (over-confident, mode-collapsing) it triggers shivering — injecting extra Langevin noise to re-explore. Crucially the set-point itself can be transiently raised like a fever to escape spurious modes early in sampling, then lowered for sharp finishing. Mantle plumes model rare exploratory excursions: occasionally a buoyant 'thermal diapir' of elevated temperature detaches from a deep, stuck latent region and rises, locally and briefly re-noising a sub-region of the sample so a small patch can re-melt and recrystallize into a better local structure (decompression-melting analogue) without disturbing the converged remainder. Update: noise_scale_t and guidance_w_t = PID(T_core_t - setpoint_t); plume events sampled with low rate, applying localized re-noising to high-residual spatial blocks. New capability: self-regulating, fever-then-anneal sampling with targeted local refinement, improving sample diversity-fidelity trade-off without retuning the schedule.

constructs.merged_construct: Wound-Healing Phased LoRA Adaptation with Glacier Accumulation-Ablation Budgeting
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: The ordered hemostasis-inflammation-proliferation-remodeling program of tissue repair and the accumulation-versus-ablation mass balance of glaciers are physiology and glaciology; parameter-efficient fine-tuning never models adaptation as a healing or mass-balance process.
constructs.mechanism: Borrow wound healing's temporally phased dynamics to schedule LoRA adaptation. A fine-tuning 'injury' (large task loss on the frozen base) launches four phases on the adapter ranks: (1) hemostasis — immediately clamp/stabilize the most disrupted directions with a low-rank fibrin patch; (2) inflammation — recruit extra transient rank and high learning rate to clear large errors; (3) proliferation — granulation: grow new low-rank directions where residual error persists; (4) remodeling — slowly prune and re-align ranks (collagen cross-linking) into a compact final BA, raising effective adapter quality per parameter. Phase transitions are gated by error-clearance signals rather than fixed steps, so easy tasks heal fast and hard ones linger in proliferation. Glacier mass balance governs the total rank budget as a conserved 'ice' mass: accumulation adds rank where high task 'snowfall' (gradient flux) lands in the upper layers, ablation melts rank where it sits below an equilibrium-line altitude of utility; net mass balance keeps the adapter's parameter count near a target while letting rank flow from low-value to high-value layers like ice creep. Update: phase(t) advances on clearance thresholds; rank_l <- rank_l + accumulation_l - ablation_l with global mass conservation. New capability: self-sizing, wound-like LoRA that allocates capacity exactly where and when the task needs repair, at fixed average budget.

constructs.merged_construct: Gate-Control Pain Inhibition for Gradient Routing with River-Delta Distributary Sharding
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Spinal dorsal-horn gating of nociceptive versus tactile fibers and avulsion-driven distributary channel switching at river deltas are neurophysiology and geomorphology; routing reasoning-vs-tool gradients to disjoint adapters has no connection to either.
constructs.mechanism: Import gate-control theory to resolve DART's gradient interference between reasoning and tool-use tokens. Model each LoRA adapter's interneuron 'gate' in the dorsal horn: large-diameter (high-confidence reasoning) fiber activity closes the gate to small-diameter (noisy tool-use) nociceptive gradients, so when a token is confidently a reasoning token its gradient inhibits leakage of conflicting tool-use updates into the shared backbone, and vice versa, implementing soft, activity-dependent disjointness instead of hard token-type routing. The gate's inhibitory interneuron is a learned function of the two fiber inputs' relative magnitudes, giving descending top-down modulation (a controller can globally raise inhibition to favor one capability). River-delta dynamics govern how the disjoint update streams are sharded across adapter sub-channels over training: gradient 'sediment' deposits into distributary channels (rank subspaces); when a channel aggrades (saturates) an avulsion reroutes future updates to a new lower-resistance subspace, preventing any single adapter direction from silting up and spreading capacity into a fan of specialized distributaries. Update: gate g = sigma(k(|reason_grad| - |tool_grad|)); blocked-stream gradient scaled by (1-g); avulsion triggered when channel utilization > threshold, reallocating to least-used rank. New capability: continuous interference suppression with self-distributing adapter capacity, improving joint reasoning+tool-use without rigid token partitioning.

constructs.merged_construct: Pharmacokinetic Compartment Decay for KV-Cache Eviction with Atmospheric-Circulation Token Transport

parents.name: Agent Memory Below the Prompt (Persistent Q4 KV Cache)

constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Multi-compartment absorption-distribution-metabolism-elimination drug kinetics and three-cell meridional atmospheric transport are pharmacology and meteorology; quantized persistent KV-cache management for edge agents references neither.
constructs.mechanism: Borrow pharmacokinetics to govern which KV entries persist, demote in precision, or evict. Treat each cached token as a drug dose distributed across compartments of decreasing fidelity: central compartment = full-precision on-chip KV (high bioavailability), peripheral = Q4 on-disk KV, deep = compressed summary. Each token follows ADME: Absorption when first attended (entering central), Distribution as it equilibrates between central and peripheral compartments by rate constants k12/k21 set by recent attention mass, Metabolism as quantization noise accrues, and Elimination with a per-token half-life so rarely-attended tokens decay exponentially out of the cache; a 'therapeutic window' keeps total cache concentration within the device memory budget by adjusting clearance. Atmospheric circulation supplies the spatial transport law that moves tokens between compartments and across attention heads: a Hadley/Ferrel/Polar three-cell flow advects high-salience tokens 'upward' into the central compartment and subsides stale tokens, while a jet-stream-like fast channel teleports a few globally critical tokens directly to any head. Update: concentration C_token follows multi-compartment ODE with rate constants from attention; eviction when C < MEC; circulation potential reassigns compartment by salience gradient. New capability: principled, budget-respecting cache lifecycle with smooth precision demotion instead of hard eviction, extending effective context on memory-constrained edge agents.

constructs.merged_construct: Second-Price Expert Routing (Vickrey-Gated MoE)
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Sealed-bid mechanism design and sports seeding (sport/games branches) are unrelated to neural-network sparse routing; nobody designs MoE gating as a truthful auction with second-price clearing and bracket-style anti-collision seeding.
constructs.mechanism: Replace the MoE softmax-top-K gate with a per-token sealed-bid auction: each expert e emits a learned scalar 'valuation' v_e(x) of the token (a cheap bilinear score against the token's hidden state), and the router treats experts as bidders competing for the right to process the token. The K experts with highest valuations win, but each winning expert's *dispatch weight* (and the gradient gain on its valuation head) is set by the (K+1)-th highest bid rather than its own bid — a Vickrey/second-price rule that removes the incentive for any expert to inflate its valuation, empirically reducing router 'overbidding' collapse where one expert grabs everything. Seeding is imported as a capacity constraint: experts carry a running seed (their recent win count) and the dispatch matrix is built so that the two highest-seeded experts cannot both be assigned to the same token unless no lower-seeded expert clears a reserve price, spreading load like a tournament bracket keeps top seeds apart. The reserve price acts as a learnable null-route threshold so low-information tokens go to a shared dense path. This augments routing and load-balancing (not reward modeling): the auxiliary load-balance loss is replaced by the auction's own truthfulness incentive plus a seed-decay term, giving a new capability — incentive-compatible, self-balancing expert selection that resists router degeneration without a tuned balance coefficient.

constructs.merged_construct: Ko-Rule Repetition Ban for Reasoning Search
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: The Go ko rule (forbidding immediate board repetition) and Tremaux maze passage-marking are board/puzzle-game mechanics; deliberate LLM reasoning-tree search never imports a positional repetition prohibition or twice-marked-edge refusal to prevent thought cycling.
constructs.mechanism: Augment Tree-of-Thoughts (or any MCTS-style LLM reasoning search) with two anti-cycling constraints borrowed from Go's ko rule and Tremaux's maze algorithm. First, hash each partial reasoning state into a semantic fingerprint (a quantized embedding of the accumulated thought, robust to paraphrase); maintain a 'ko table' of recently expanded fingerprints, and forbid the search from re-entering a state whose fingerprint matches one visited within the last m expansions — exactly as a ko stone may not be immediately recaptured, the planner must 'play elsewhere' (expand a different branch) before it is allowed to return to a near-identical thought, breaking the loop where the model oscillates between two reformulations of the same dead end. Second, edges (state-to-next-thought transitions) are marked Tremaux-style: an edge traversed twice is refused, so a sub-line that has already been fully explored and backtracked from cannot be silently re-explored, converting the tree's effective search into a guaranteed loop-free traversal. The value function is unchanged; only the legality of expansions is inverted from 'expand the highest-value child' to 'expand the highest-value child that is neither ko-banned nor twice-marked.' This touches search/inference control (not reward modeling), giving deliberate reasoners a cheap, model-agnostic defense against thought-cycling and redundant token spend on long-horizon problems.

constructs.merged_construct: Swiss-Pairing Self-Play Curriculum (Elo-Bucketed GRPO Groups)
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Swiss tournament pairing and Elo rating are competitive-games rating/format mechanics; GRPO's intra-prompt group sampling for RL reasoning has no notion of opponent strength, score-bucketed pairing, or rematch avoidance.
constructs.mechanism: Reshape how GRPO forms its sampling groups by borrowing Swiss-system pairing dynamics over prompts rather than players. Maintain an Elo-style difficulty rating for every training prompt, updated after each rollout batch: if the current policy solves a prompt (high group reward), the prompt's rating drops a few points; if it fails, the rating jumps (a low-rated 'player' beating a high-rated one moves ratings sharply, as in Elo). Each optimization round, prompts are paired into a training batch Swiss-style — grouped with other prompts of similar current rating (similar cumulative 'score' against the policy) so the policy always trains against a band of prompts right at its competence frontier, and a prompt is not resampled until other equal-rated prompts have been seen (the no-rematch constraint), which de-correlates the group-relative advantage estimates and prevents the model from grinding the same few examples. Within each Swiss-paired prompt, GRPO still samples G outputs and normalizes rewards by group mean/std as usual; the only change is which prompts populate the round and how their selection probability tracks live Elo. This is a data-sampling / curriculum mechanism (not a reward-model change): it yields an automatic, self-calibrating difficulty schedule that keeps gradient signal informative as the policy improves, replacing fixed or hand-tuned curriculum stages.

constructs.merged_construct: Handicap-Equalized Expert Capacity Control
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Golf handicapping (equalizing players of unequal skill via score adjustment) and chess zugzwang (forced detrimental move) are sport/games equalization and tempo concepts; Switch Transformer top-1 routing and its capacity factor have no handicap-index adjustment or forced-suboptimal-assignment law.
constructs.mechanism: Import golf's handicap law into Switch Transformer's top-1 router to control expert load, and use zugzwang to handle capacity overflow. Each expert maintains a 'handicap index' computed from its recent routing differential — roughly (recent-token-share minus fair-share), low-pass filtered like a golfer's index from recent score differentials. At routing time the raw gate logits are adjusted by subtracting each expert's course-scaled handicap (strong/over-subscribed experts are penalized so weaker/under-used experts become competitive for marginal tokens), exactly as a handicap lets unequal players compete on net score; this replaces the auxiliary load-balancing loss with a deterministic, interpretable per-step adjustment that needs no balancing coefficient. When an expert hits its capacity-factor limit and a token would normally be dropped, the router invokes a zugzwang rule: rather than silently dropping (a free 'pass'), it is *forced to move* the token to its best legal (non-full) expert even if that expert is a poor match, and the magnitude of the resulting routing mismatch is logged as a tempo penalty that further raises the saturated expert's next-step handicap. This is a routing / capacity-control mechanism (not reward modeling): the new capability is token-drop-free, self-equalizing sparse routing whose load behavior is governed by a transparent control law instead of an opaque tuned loss.

constructs.merged_construct: Cascade-Aware De-Herding for Self-Consistency Voting

parents.name: Best-of-N Sampling (Inference-Time Scaling via Rejection Sampling)

constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Information cascades and social proof (social-science economics/psychology of herding on visible predecessor actions) are about human crowds discarding private signals; best-of-N / self-consistency voting over LLM samples is normally treated as i.i.d. evidence with no model of imitative herding among the samples.
constructs.mechanism: Treat the well-known fragility of majority-vote self-consistency — where many sampled chains converge on the same confident-but-wrong answer — as a literal information cascade and counter it. When generating N samples sequentially with any shared context (few-shot exemplars, retrieved snippets, or a visible scratchpad), each sample is an 'agent' whose answer can be driven more by the public signal (the dominant emerging answer) than by its own private reasoning, reproducing the cascade failure where early agreement snowballs regardless of correctness. The mechanism estimates, per sample, a 'private-signal weight' = the divergence between that chain's internal token-level evidence (e.g., entropy/log-prob along its reasoning) and the running plurality answer; samples that merely echo the plurality with low private divergence are *down-weighted* in the final vote (social-proof discounting), while samples that reach the same answer via independent evidence count fully. To actively break cascades the sampler also injects controlled signal-perturbation for a fraction of samples (hidden exemplar shuffling / temperature bumps) so they cannot observe the same public anchor, restoring independence of evidence. This modifies evaluation/aggregation at inference time (not the reward model): it yields calibrated, cascade-robust voting that resists confidently-wrong consensus and improves best-of-N accuracy where naive majority voting plateaus.

constructs.merged_construct: Branching-Bandit Async Rollout Scheduler with Little's-Law Staleness Budget
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Queueing theory and Little's law (daily-life operations-research mechanics of arrival/service rates and L=lambda*W) are not part of agentic-RL training infrastructure; decoupled rollout-as-a-service systems schedule rollouts by availability, not by a queue-stability control law bounding policy staleness.
constructs.mechanism: Govern ProRL's decoupled rollout-as-a-service queue with an explicit queueing-theory control law instead of ad-hoc dispatch. Model the rollout pipeline as an M/M/c system: prompts arrive at rate lambda into the rollout workers (c servers, service rate mu per multi-turn episode), and trainer consumption is the departure process. The scheduler continuously estimates utilization rho = lambda/(c*mu) and uses Little's law L = lambda*W to convert a target *policy-staleness budget* (max acceptable wall-clock W between a rollout's generation and its use in a gradient step) into an admissible in-flight rollout count L; admission control then throttles new rollout launches whenever in-flight count exceeds L, guaranteeing bounded off-policyness rather than letting stale trajectories pile up when the trainer falls behind. When rho approaches 1 (rollouts outpacing training), the law triggers either spinning up more rollout servers c or shedding low-priority prompts; when rho is low, more exploratory rollouts are admitted to fill the queue. This is async-RL training infrastructure / data-pipeline control (not reward modeling): the new capability is a principled, self-tuning throttle that keeps the importance-sampling correction valid by holding trajectory staleness inside a provable bound derived directly from arrival/service statistics, replacing brittle fixed rollout-batch sizes.

constructs.merged_construct: Tit-for-Tat Credit Assignment for Multi-Agent LLM Cooperation

parents.name: Multi-Agent RL for Dynamic Pricing: Balancing Profitability, Stability and Fairness (MAPPO/MADDPG)

constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Tit-for-tat and the prisoner's dilemma (game-theory branch) describe pairwise reciprocity strategies between human-like agents; cooperative multi-agent RL with centralized critics assigns credit via value decomposition, not via a reciprocal punish/forgive trace between agents.
constructs.mechanism: Restructure inter-agent credit assignment in a cooperative MARL system (MAPPO/MADDPG-style, e.g., a team of LLM agents that must share information or compute) by overlaying a tit-for-tat reciprocity ledger derived from the iterated prisoner's dilemma. Each ordered agent pair (i,j) maintains a scalar reciprocity state initialized to 'cooperate'; at every interaction step the system labels agent i's action toward j as cooperative or defecting using a cheap proxy (did i pass useful tokens/sub-results, or did it free-ride / withhold?). The shaping term injected into i's advantage mirrors tit-for-tat: i is rewarded for cooperating when j cooperated last round (nice + forgiving) and penalized when it defects, while j's policy is given license to retaliate-once (a transient negative shaping toward i) when i defected, then forgive — turning a one-shot defection-dominant interaction into the cooperative equilibrium of the repeated game. Crucially this is a *credit-assignment / advantage-shaping* layer over the existing centralized critic (not a reward model): the environment reward is untouched, but the per-agent advantages are reshaped by the reciprocity ledger so that exploitative behaviors (social-loafing, information-hoarding) become individually disadvantageous. The new capability is emergent, training-time-stable cooperation among self-interested learning agents without a hand-designed cooperation bonus, with the forgiveness rule preventing mutual-defection collapse.

constructs.merged_construct: Divide-and-Choose Gradient Arbitration for Multi-Task LoRA
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Divide-and-choose and proportional fair cake-cutting (fair-division games branch) are envy-free resource-splitting protocols for heterogeneous goods; multi-adapter / multi-task fine-tuning resolves gradient conflicts by projection or weighting, never by an envy-free cut-and-choose over a shared parameter budget.
constructs.mechanism: Generalize DART's idea of routing conflicting capabilities to disjoint LoRA adapters by deciding the *boundary* between them with a divide-and-choose fair-division protocol over the shared low-rank update budget, instead of a fixed token-type rule. Treat each training step's available update directions (the top singular directions of the combined gradient for tasks A and B over a frozen backbone) as a heterogeneous, divisible 'cake'. One task plays divider: it proposes a partition of the rank-r subspace into two pieces it values as equal (i.e., its loss-reduction is split evenly across the two halves, computed via per-direction gradient-alignment scores). The other task plays chooser: it takes whichever piece yields it the larger loss reduction; the divider keeps the rest. Each task's LoRA adapter is then updated only within its allotted subspace this step, guaranteeing a proportional, low-envy split where neither task is starved of capacity it values, and roles alternate across steps for symmetry. This directly attacks gradient interference at the level of *parameter/capacity allocation* (architecture + optimization, not reward modeling): conflicting tasks never write to the same directions in the same step, but the allocation is adaptive and fairness-guaranteed rather than statically partitioned. The new capability is interference-free multi-task adaptation with a provable per-step fairness property, scaling to more than two tasks via moving-knife extensions of cake-cutting.

constructs.merged_construct: Card-Counting Depletion Sampler for Without-Replacement Data Selection
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Blackjack card counting (a running deck-composition tally driving bet sizing) and poker pot-odds (equity-vs-price thresholds) are casino-games strategy; contrastive minibatch construction and negative sampling have no running depletion count or odds-gated inclusion of examples.
constructs.mechanism: Borrow blackjack's running-count dynamics to construct contrastive minibatches that sample hard negatives without replacement in an exhaustion-aware way. Partition the embedding space (or label/cluster space) into 'card values': clusters that supply informative hard negatives are tagged high-value, clusters that supply easy/redundant negatives are low-value. As an epoch draws examples without replacement, maintain a running count that rises when low-value (easy) examples are dealt out (the remaining pool is now richer in hard negatives — a 'hot deck') and falls when high-value examples are consumed. The minibatch sampler's 'bet size' — how aggressively it pulls hard negatives and how large the negative set is for the NT-Xent loss — scales with the running count, exactly as a counter raises the bet when the shoe is rich. A pot-odds gate decides per-candidate inclusion: a candidate negative is admitted only if its estimated 'equity' (expected gradient contribution, proxied by current similarity to the anchor) exceeds the 'price' of including it (its compute cost / its risk of being a false negative), mirroring calling only when equity beats pot odds. This operates purely on *data sampling / curriculum* for self-supervised training (not reward modeling): the new capability is an adaptive negative-mining schedule that automatically intensifies hardness as the easy examples deplete within each pass, improving representation quality per compute without a fixed hard-negative ratio.

constructs.merged_construct: Stare-Decisis Precedent Binding with Burden-of-Proof Retrieval Gating
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Stare decisis (binding precedent hierarchy) and burden of proof / standards of evidence (social-science law branch) are courtroom evidentiary doctrines; RAG retrieves and conditions on top-K documents with no notion of binding prior answers, vertical authority, or an evidentiary sufficiency threshold gating generation.
constructs.mechanism: Wrap a RAG system in two legal control laws governing how retrieved evidence and prior answers may be used. Stare decisis is imported as a precedent cache: past (query, grounded-answer, citations) tuples are stored with an authority level (e.g., human-verified > self-consistent > single-shot). On a new query, if a sufficiently similar precedent of high authority exists, the generator is *bound* to follow it unless the newly retrieved documents materially conflict — vertical stare decisis means a low-authority cached answer cannot override a high-authority one, and the model must explicitly 'distinguish' (justify departure from) a binding precedent before contradicting it, yielding answer consistency across a deployment. Burden of proof becomes a retrieval-sufficiency gate: before the generator is permitted to assert a factual claim, the retrieved evidence for that claim must clear a configurable standard — 'preponderance' (one strong corroborating passage) for low-stakes queries, 'beyond reasonable doubt' (multiple independent agreeing sources, no strong contradicting source) for high-stakes ones; claims failing the standard are either abstained on or hedged, and the burden of production sits with retrieval (it must surface enough to put the claim 'before the trier'). This modifies retrieval conditioning and generation-gating / evaluation (not reward modeling): the new capability is stakes-calibrated, precedent-consistent grounded generation that abstains rather than hallucinating when evidence is insufficient.

constructs.merged_construct: Separating-Equilibrium Signalling Filter for Synthetic Data Curation
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Spence signalling and Akerlof adverse selection (information-economics, social-science branch) describe markets for goods of hidden quality where costly signals separate types; AI-feedback data pipelines curate synthetic/self-generated examples by score or filtering, with no model of hidden-quality markets, costly separating signals, or lemons-driven quality collapse.
constructs.mechanism: Frame the known degradation of AI-generated training data — where a teacher/judge model is gamed by superficially-good-but-hollow samples, driving a 'lemons' collapse in dataset quality — as adverse selection, and fix it with a Spence-style costly-signal separating mechanism. The data 'market' contains candidate (prompt, response) pairs of hidden true quality; a naive RLAIF judge that scores on surface features suffers adverse selection because high-surface/low-substance generations are cheap to produce and crowd out genuinely good ones, lowering the effective quality the student learns from. The mechanism requires each candidate to emit a *costly signal* that only high-true-quality responses can cheaply afford: e.g., passing an independently expensive verification (executing its own code, surviving a perturbation/consistency probe, or reconstructing a held-out part of its reasoning) — analogous to education signalling productivity by being too costly for low types to mimic. Only candidates whose signal cost is justified by their quality enter the separating equilibrium and are kept for training; the judge is recalibrated to price the signal, not the surface. This operates entirely on *data sampling / curation* upstream of training (not on the reward model's architecture): the new capability is a self-curating synthetic-data pipeline that provably separates substantive from hollow generations and halts lemons-style quality decay in iterated self-training / distillation.

constructs.merged_construct: Caravanserai Speculative Staging
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Pre-industrial caravan logistics (fixed day-march shelters) and the Roman imperial relay post system are about feeding animals and changing fresh horses; nothing in that world references autoregressive token verification. The merge maps overland staging geometry onto a draft/target token pipeline.
constructs.mechanism: Replace the fixed 'draft K tokens then verify once' schedule of speculative decoding with a staged relay where draft length is set adaptively like caravanserai spacing: the draft model advances only as far as it can before predicted per-token entropy crosses a 'nightfall' threshold (analogous to a caravan never travelling past where it can reach shelter), then halts for a target-model verification 'station'. Borrowing cursus publicus's two-tier posts (mutationes for fast horse swaps, mansiones for full rest), we run two draft tiers: a tiny tier that proposes between every verification (cheap horse swap) and a mid tier that is re-seeded only at full verification stations. The verification cadence is itself a learned controller that lengthens drafts in low-uncertainty stretches and shortens them near high-entropy 'terrain', maximizing accepted-token throughput per target forward pass. Rejected tokens roll the cursor back to the last station rather than to token zero, so partial progress between stations is preserved. The new capability is variable-stride speculation that provably never exceeds the draft's reliable horizon, reducing wasted target compute relative to fixed-K decoding.

constructs.merged_construct: Etak Dead-Reckoning State Filter
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Open-ocean Pacific navigation that advances a position fix from heading/speed/time and reframes the canoe as stationary while reference islands slide past has no contact with hardware-aware selective recurrences; the link is the shared structure of accumulating, then resetting, integration error.
constructs.mechanism: Augment Mamba's selective state update by treating the recurrent state as a dead-reckoning position estimate that accrues drift over long sequences, and add an Etak-style moving-reference correction. Concretely, the input-dependent gate Delta is reinterpreted as a confidence-weighted step size: when the current token strongly matches a learned 'reference landmark' embedding (a small bank of anchor vectors), the model performs an Etak update that re-expresses the hidden state relative to the passing reference (a learned affine reset toward the anchor) instead of integrating blindly. Between landmarks the state integrates ordinary selective updates (pure dead reckoning), and a per-channel drift estimator tracks expected integration error growing as sqrt(steps). When accumulated drift exceeds a threshold the next landmark match triggers a stronger correction, mirroring how navigators take an etak-island bearing to cancel cumulative course error. This gives the SSM an explicit, cheap error-resetting mechanism for very long contexts where fixed-size recurrent memory otherwise degrades, without reintroducing quadratic attention.

constructs.merged_construct: Qanat Gradient-Calibrated Residual Stream
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Ancient gravity-fed water tunnels engineered to a slope 'just steep enough to flow but not so steep it erodes the channel or silts' are a hydraulic-civil concern with no relation to activation normalization; the borrowed dynamic is the maintained shallow monotone gradient over great length.
constructs.mechanism: Replace the single learnable scale of RMSNorm with a depth-indexed 'gradient schedule' borrowed from qanat slope calibration: across the residual stream, the per-layer rescale factor is constrained to follow a gently monotone profile so the expected activation-norm change per block stays inside a narrow band (too large erodes signal into explosion, too small silts into vanishing/rank-collapse). Each block measures the realized norm change and applies a corrective scaling that nudges it back toward the target shallow slope, exactly as aqueduct engineers held ~1:4800 over kilometers. The schedule is parameterized by two scalars (source head-room and target per-block drop) shared across depth, learned end to end, giving an inductive bias toward smooth signal propagation. Optionally a 'mother-well' input gain sets the initial activation reservoir. The new capability is training-stable very deep stacks with a principled, interpretable propagation profile that controls both forward norm growth and the implied backward gradient slope, reducing the need for warmup and aggressive clipping.

constructs.merged_construct: Seriation Latent-Order Recovery
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Frequency seriation orders undated potsherd assemblages into a chronology from the rise-and-fall abundance of design styles, and wayfinding anchors position by hierarchically salient landmarks; neither concerns transport couplings or unlabeled latent-axis recovery in ML.
constructs.mechanism: Build an unsupervised method that recovers a one-dimensional latent ordering (e.g., the implicit timeline of unlabeled data shards, diffusion noise levels, or checkpoint snapshots) by transferring seriation's battleship-curve assumption. Represent each item by its feature-occurrence histogram; the goal is a permutation under which every feature's marginal abundance is unimodal along the axis (rises then falls), the core frequency-seriation criterion. We cast finding this permutation as an optimal-transport problem: solve for a doubly-stochastic coupling between items and positions on a line that minimizes a Wasserstein cost penalizing non-unimodal feature trajectories, relaxing the hard permutation to a transport plan and rounding via Sinkhorn. Wayfinding contributes a hierarchical anchoring prior: a few high-salience items with known order pin the axis endpoints and most-distinctive waypoints, constraining the coupling and resolving the reflection/scale ambiguity inherent to seriation. The deliverable is a differentiable seriation layer that orders unlabeled collections along a meaningful latent progression for curriculum construction or temporal pretraining without timestamps.

constructs.merged_construct: Double-Entry Conservation Audit
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Mercantile bookkeeping where every debit equals a credit, and split hazelwood tally sticks whose two halves must re-match, are medieval accounting controls; gradient checkpointing is a memory/recompute tradeoff. The merge inverts checkpointing's purpose into a tamper/corruption-evident ledger.
constructs.mechanism: Invert gradient checkpointing from a pure memory optimization into an integrity-audited recomputation by importing double-entry's balancing invariant and the tally stick's split-half matching. At each checkpoint we store, alongside the saved activations, a cheap conserved scalar 'balance' for the segment (e.g., a signed sum of activation statistics that, under the segment's linearized map, must equal a corresponding quantity recomputed in the backward pass) - the forward 'debit' and backward 'credit' that are required to net to zero. When activations are recomputed from a checkpoint during backprop, the recomputed balance is matched against the stored one like the two halves of a split tally; a mismatch flags silent data corruption, nondeterministic-kernel divergence, or a faulty recompute on a specific accelerator. To make it robust under distributed/low-precision training, each segment keeps redundant notched 'denomination' hashes at multiple granularities (coarse and fine notches) so the location of a discrepancy can be bisected. The new capability is corruption-evident training: checkpointed recomputation that not only saves memory but continuously self-verifies, catching hardware faults that ordinary checkpointing would silently propagate into the gradient.

constructs.merged_construct: Line-of-Sight Hop Relay Attention
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Hilltop smoke/fire chains that propagate a message only between mutually visible stations, and Persian Royal-Road courier relays that hand dispatches station-to-station, are visibility-and-horse logistics; swapping that physical relay substrate for the device-to-device KV exchange of distributed attention is far from any human framing.
constructs.mechanism: Modify Ring Attention so KV blocks are not unconditionally forwarded to every device in the ring but are propagated hop-by-hop under a learned 'visibility' gate, mirroring smoke-signal line-of-sight chains and chapar-khaneh staged hand-offs. Each device computes a cheap relevance summary of its query block against an incoming KV block; if the summary falls below a station-specific threshold the block is consumed locally and a compressed 'dispatch' (a low-rank or top-m token digest) is forwarded instead of the full KV, cutting inter-device bandwidth. Relevant blocks are relayed in full to the next station, so important context travels far down the ring while irrelevant context dies at the first hop, exactly as a signal fire only re-lights where the next hilltop can see useful information. A small number of always-relayed 'beacon' tokens (global anchors) guarantee a connected backbone so no device is fully isolated. The result is bandwidth-adaptive long-context attention that preserves Ring Attention's exact-softmax accumulation on relayed blocks while spending communication only where cross-block attention mass is high.

constructs.merged_construct: Craft-Doneness Endpoint Head

parents.name: Blacksmithing / forge welding heat judged by color

constructs.cognitive_distance_note: A smith reading incandescent steel color to infer an unmeasured forge temperature, and a vintner calling the pick date from tasting skins and seeds, are tacit sensory endpoint judgments; probing classifiers read frozen internal representations for linguistic properties. The merge swaps the physical 'doneness' substrate for training-progress state.
constructs.mechanism: Train a frozen-backbone probe to act as a 'doneness' detector that infers an unobservable internal readiness variable from cheap surface proxies, imitating how a smith maps glow-color to hidden temperature and a winemaker maps taste cues to ripeness. The probe reads a panel of inexpensive, always-available signals from a running model - layerwise activation-norm color, gradient-noise scale, validation-free self-consistency, representation rank - and is trained against sparse, expensive ground-truth 'optimal stop' labels (best-checkpoint markers, peak downstream score) to predict a calibrated readiness score per step. Because the true endpoint window is narrow and asymmetric (over-firing ruins the weld; over-ripening unbalances the wine), the loss is asymmetric and the probe outputs an uncertainty band, escalating to a full (costly) evaluation only when it judges the system inside the ambiguous window. Deployed as an early-stop / harvest controller, it ends training, fine-tuning, or distillation at the predicted peak using only surface telemetry, replacing fixed step counts and rare full evaluations with a learned sensory endpoint call transferable across runs of the same recipe.

constructs.merged_construct: Central-Place Expert Geography
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Christaller's settlement geography (threshold population, market range, hierarchical higher-order goods) and the Mongol yam relay spacing govern where towns and post-stations sit on a landscape; MoE routing is a learned sparse gate. Importing settlement-viability and relay-spacing laws as routing control is outside any human MoE intuition.
constructs.mechanism: Govern MoE routing with central-place control laws instead of only a softmax gate plus load-balance loss. Each expert is a 'central place' with two imported parameters: a threshold (minimum routed token mass per batch below which the expert is deemed non-viable and its capacity/learning-rate is shrunk or it is merged with a neighbor) and a range (a soft radius in router-embedding space beyond which tokens are not served by that expert, forcing distant tokens to higher-order experts). Experts are organized hierarchically as in central-place theory: many low-order experts handle common, low-threshold 'goods' (frequent token patterns) while a few high-order experts, placed to cover the embedding space like rare regional capitals, handle rare high-threshold patterns. The yam contributes a spacing constraint: expert centroids are regularized to a roughly uniform day-march separation in router space so coverage has no gaps or wasteful overlaps, and a token always reaches a serving expert within a bounded number of routing hops. This yields self-organizing, gap-free expert specialization with explicit viability and coverage guarantees, improving load balance and reducing dead/redundant experts versus auxiliary-loss balancing alone.

constructs.merged_construct: Quipu Positional KV Ledger
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Inca knotted-cord recording, where knot type and position on a pendant encode decimal place value and cord color encodes data category, and the periodic Roman census that re-enumerates the population by ward and tribe, are administrative memory technologies; substituting their encoding/refresh logic for a linear-attention recurrent KV memory is human-blind.
constructs.mechanism: Restructure Gated DeltaNet-2's fixed-size recurrent (compressed KV) memory as a quipu-style ledger with category-coded, place-valued slots and a census-style periodic re-enumeration. The compressed state is partitioned into colored 'cords' (channel groups), each dedicated to a learned data category, and within a cord a positional knot code assigns higher-significance subspaces to more salient/recent associations, so writes deposit information at a place-value determined by an importance gate rather than overwriting uniformly. DeltaNet-2's decoupled erase/write gates become the act of untying and retying knots: erase loosens a specific place-valued slot without scrambling neighbors, write ties a new knot at the computed significance. Periodically (every T tokens) a lightweight 'census' pass re-enumerates the ledger: it recomputes per-cord summary tallies, compacts stale low-significance knots, and rebalances place values so capacity is reallocated to currently active categories, exactly as a census re-tallies by tribe. The new capability is an interpretable, category-addressable linear-attention memory whose contents can be audited and whose capacity is dynamically rebalanced, improving long-range associative recall and editability over an opaque fixed-size state.

constructs.merged_construct: Solera Taste-Gated Teacher Blend

parents.name: Solera capataz extraction-timing judgment (deciding when/how much wine to draw via venencia tasting)
Whisky master-blender batch-consistency judgment (composing a consistent product from variable casks by nose)

constructs.cognitive_distance_note: The criaderas-y-solera fractional-blending system, where a capataz tastes before each partial draw to keep character constant across years of variable casks, and a whisky blender who nudges every batch by nose to hold the house flavor, are sensory consistency crafts; DINO's EMA teacher is a self-distillation trick. The borrowed dynamic is fractional partial blending under a tasted target.
constructs.mechanism: Generalize DINO's exponential-moving-average teacher into a solera fractional-blend governed by a learned 'taste' consistency target, to stabilize self-supervised training across variable data/checkpoints. Maintain a small criadera of teacher snapshots (tiers) instead of one EMA copy; at each step a fraction is drawn from the freshest student-influenced tier and replenished down the chain, so each teacher tier is a fractional blend of all prior students - the solera invariant that no single 'cask' (checkpoint) dominates and old character persists. The whisky-blender contribution is a taste gate: rather than blending by a fixed EMA rate, a cheap consistency critic measures how far the candidate blended teacher drifts from a target behavioral signature (e.g., centering statistics, feature-distribution moments held constant like a house flavor) and adjusts the draw fraction per tier to hold that signature steady batch to batch, damping collapse and run-to-run variance. Like the capataz never drawing blindly, replenishment is skipped when the consistency critic judges the draw would degrade the target. The result is a self-distillation teacher with built-in long-memory smoothing and an explicit constant-character constraint, more robust to noisy batches and distribution shift than a single-rate EMA.

constructs.merged_construct: Drifting-Landmark Test-Time Localizer
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Arctic orientation by reading wind-carved sastrugi ridges and named winds on featureless ice, and the unavoidable distortion theorem of flattening a sphere onto a map, are tacit navigation and cartography; CANDI is a test-time-adaptation module for time-series anomaly detection. The shared failure mode is localizing against references that themselves drift and are known-distorted.
constructs.mechanism: Extend test-time adaptation (CANDI) to operate against slowly-drifting reference statistics with a known, modeled distortion, mirroring sastrugi navigation under an imperfect projection. The normality/reference embedding used to score new streaming data is not held fixed but is treated like sastrugi ridges that re-form with the prevailing 'wind': a slow drift model predicts how the reference shifts under the current distribution regime, and adaptation corrects the score for that predicted drift before deciding anomaly versus benign shift, reducing the false positives CANDI's mining targets. The map-projection insight supplies a calibrated distortion correction: because the mapping from raw feature space to the model's representation provably cannot be both distance- and density-preserving, we fit an explicit per-region distortion field and de-skew distances before normality comparison, so that 'far from normal' is measured in corrected coordinates rather than raw ones. False-positive-mined exemplars become 'named winds' - recurring drift directions cached and reused to anticipate the next shift.
