The new capability is robust streaming detection that distinguishes genuine anomalies from mere reference drift under a quantified representational distortion, where vanilla TTA would chase the moving baseline.

constructs.merged_construct: Sandhi-Gated KV Cache: context-boundary token rewriting before attention
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: GQA is a KV-cache compression trick from systems engineering; tone sandhi is a phonological rule from East Asian linguistics where a tone mutates obligatorily based on its neighbor; counterpoint is a Renaissance voice-leading discipline. No researcher links GPU memory layout to obligatory phonological mutation or species counterpoint.
constructs.mechanism: Replace the static key projection in GQA with a context-conditioned 'sandhi rewrite' applied to each key vector before it is written to the shared group cache. As in tone sandhi, where a syllable's surface tone is a deterministic function of the categorical tone of its right neighbor, each key k_i is mapped to a rewritten key k_i' = R(k_i, class(k_{i+1})) where class() is a learned discrete bucketing (VQ codebook) of the following token's key. The rewrite R is a small per-bucket affine transform, so a token's cached key depends on its local successor context rather than only its own content. Borrowing counterpoint's voice-independence constraint, keys belonging to different query groups are forced (via an orthogonality penalty between group key subspaces) to occupy disjoint subspaces so that group caches do not collide. This yields a cache whose entries are context-stabilized at write time, improving retrieval of phrase-boundary tokens and reducing the need for sliding-window re-attention, while keeping GQA's (H/G) memory savings.

constructs.merged_construct: Vowel-Harmony Decoding: long-range feature-agreement constraint over the generated sequence
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Speculative decoding is an inference-acceleration draft-verify scheme; vowel harmony and grammatical agreement are long-distance morphophonological/syntactic constraints from Turkic/Finno-Ugric linguistics that force non-adjacent elements to share feature values. Speed-up algorithms and agreement morphology never meet.
constructs.mechanism: Invert speculative decoding's role: instead of the small draft model only proposing tokens for speed, give the draft model a discrete 'feature register' (a small set of latent harmony features, e.g. a 4-bit vector) that is set by an early committed 'trigger' token and must be propagated to all later tokens in the spanning domain, exactly as a vowel-harmony trigger forces all later vowels in a word to match its backness/rounding feature. During verification, the target model accepts a drafted token only if its predicted feature register agrees with the active trigger's register (a hard agreement constraint imposed as a logit mask over feature-incompatible tokens); on disagreement the token is rejected and resampled. The harmony domain is opened by structural tokens (sentence start, quotation, code block) and closed by domain-final tokens, giving long-range, non-adjacent enforcement of stylistic/register consistency that ordinary local sampling cannot guarantee. New capability: provably consistent long-range attributes (tense, formality register, variable naming convention) at near-speculative-decoding throughput.

constructs.merged_construct: Leitmotif Retrieval Tags: semantic-cell index keys that recur on referent salience
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: RAG is a dense-retriever-plus-generator pipeline; the leitmotif is a Wagnerian compositional device where a short musical cell tags a character/concept and recurs whenever the referent becomes relevant; deixis is the linguistic anchoring of meaning to a speaker-centered origo. Opera orchestration and vector retrieval are unrelated.
constructs.mechanism: Transfer the leitmotif's structure into the RAG index: each stored document chunk is augmented not with a single dense vector but with a learned short 'motif' embedding bound to the salient entity/concept the chunk concerns, plus a deictic origo vector encoding the chunk's point-of-reference (who/when/where it speaks from). Retrieval fires a motif when its bound referent becomes active in the query state, the way a leitmotif sounds whenever its character becomes relevant even if off-stage: the retriever scores chunks by motif-to-active-entity match weighted by deictic compatibility (same speaker/time frame) rather than raw query-chunk cosine similarity alone. Concretely, an entity-tracking head maintains a running set of active referent motifs from the generated context; at each retrieval step the top-K is selected by max over active-motif inner products, so a referent introduced early keeps pulling its associated evidence forward across long generations. This gives entity-persistent, viewpoint-consistent retrieval and reduces the classic RAG failure of losing track of a referent mentioned many tokens earlier.

constructs.merged_construct: Jata-Patha Redundant Checkpointing: interleaved-reversal recomputation for error-resilient activations
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Gradient checkpointing is a memory-for-compute tradeoff in deep-learning training; Vedic jata/ghana chanting is a 2500-year-old oral error-correcting code that recites each word forward, backward, and re-forward in interlocked pairs to make zero-drift transmission; reduplication is morphological repetition. Ritual mnemonics and backprop memory management have no contact.
constructs.mechanism: Borrow jata-patha's interlocked redundancy to make recomputation error-resilient under low precision. In standard checkpointing, non-saved activations are recomputed once from the nearest checkpoint; under fp8/aggressive quantization this recompute can diverge from the original forward values, corrupting gradients. The jata scheme recomputes each segment in an interlocked pattern (forward, then reverse-order recompute of an overlapping pair, then forward again) and votes/averages the redundant estimates of the boundary activations, exactly as the chant's pairwise reversal pins each word against drift. Reduplication contributes the rule that only the segment-boundary activations (the analog of the 'word' joints) are duplicated, keeping overhead bounded. The boundary activations agreed upon by the redundant passes are then used as anchored recompute seeds for the interior. New capability: numerically robust gradient checkpointing for very-low-precision training, trading a small constant extra recompute for elimination of recompute drift without storing more activations.

constructs.merged_construct: Apophatic Routing: experts defined by elimination rather than selection
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: MoE routing is a sparse-activation architecture; apophatic (negative) theology defines the divine purely by systematically denying every positive attribute; Occam's razor is a parsimony heuristic. A method that knows God only by what He is not, and a top-K gating softmax, share nothing.
constructs.mechanism: Invert the MoE gate from positive top-K selection to apophatic elimination. Instead of a router emitting affirmative scores and keeping the highest-K experts, train a 'negation head' that emits a denial score for each expert -- a calibrated probability that this expert is wrong for the token -- and the token is routed to the experts that survive after iteratively removing the most-confidently-denied ones, stopping when removing another would discard support (an Occam stopping rule that halts at the smallest surviving set still covering the token's predicted loss). The denial scores are supervised by per-expert counterfactual loss (the increase in loss when an expert is masked), so the head learns negative evidence directly. This addresses MoE's known router miscalibration and expert collapse: negative routing produces sharper specialization because experts are excluded for concrete reasons, and the parsimony stop adaptively varies the active-expert count per token (hard tokens keep more survivors) instead of a fixed K. Implementable as a drop-in replacement for the gating softmax plus an auxiliary counterfactual-loss target.

constructs.merged_construct: Counterpoint Attention: voice-independence orthogonality across attention heads with consonance coupling
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Multi-head attention is a transformer primitive; species counterpoint is a strict compositional craft demanding that voices stay melodically independent yet harmonically consonant; polyrhythm superposes metric streams that realign only at the least common multiple. Bach's voice-leading rules and softmax(QK^T) are never connected.
constructs.mechanism: Borrow counterpoint's twin dynamics -- voice independence plus enforced consonance -- as a head-coordination regularizer. Standard heads are free to redundantly co-attend (head collapse). Treat each head as a contrapuntal 'voice': impose (1) an independence term penalizing high correlation between heads' attention distributions over the same query (so voices move differently, like forbidden parallel motion suppression), and (2) a consonance term that rewards configurations where the combined value outputs of all heads at a position form a low-rank 'chord' consistent with the residual-stream subspace, mirroring counterpoint's rule that simultaneous independent lines must still resolve consonantly. Polyrhythm contributes a phase structure: heads are assigned different positional periodicities (distinct RoPE base frequencies forming integer ratios like 3:2) so that heads emphasize attention at staggered token strides and only jointly 'align' at LCM positions, encouraging multi-scale temporal coverage. The result is heads that are simultaneously diverse (independent) and globally coherent (consonant), improving long-range coverage and reducing redundant-head waste without adding parameters.

constructs.merged_construct: Liminal Curriculum: rite-of-passage three-phase schedule with attribute-stripping in the middle
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Knowledge distillation transfers a teacher's soft targets to a student; van Gennep's rite of passage is an anthropological tripartite structure (separation, liminal, incorporation) in which the initiate is stripped of identity markers before reaggregation. Ritual process theory and temperature-softmax distillation are unrelated domains.
constructs.mechanism: Import the rite-of-passage control law as a three-phase distillation schedule. Phase 1 (separation): the student is detached from its pretrained head -- the task-specific output layer is reinitialized and frozen-teacher logits begin guiding it, 'cutting it away' from prior behavior. Phase 2 (liminality): borrowing the liminal stripping of markers, the student is deliberately deprived of identifying features -- heavy activation masking/dropout, removal of positional and layernorm affine parameters, and training only against high-temperature teacher distributions with no hard labels -- forcing it into an attribute-neutral plastic state where representations are maximally reorganizable (this is the analog of the initiate being nameless and rankless). Phase 3 (incorporation): markers are restored (affine params unfrozen, hard labels reintroduced, temperature annealed to 1) and the student is 'reaggregated' with a new stable identity. The liminal stripping acts as a strong implicit regularizer that escapes the teacher's local basin before re-specializing, targeting distillation's known failure where the student merely mimics the teacher's idiosyncrasies. Concrete and schedulable as three loss/regularization regimes.

constructs.merged_construct: Boustrophedon Scan: alternating-direction bidirectional state-space recurrence
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Mamba is a hardware-aware selective state-space sequence model with a unidirectional scan; boustrophedon is an archaic writing convention where successive lines reverse direction (and letters mirror), as the ox turns in plowing; Labanotation reads movement bottom-to-top with mirrored body-side symbols. Ancient writing-direction conventions and SSM kernels are unrelated.
constructs.mechanism: Swap Mamba's purely left-to-right scan substrate for a boustrophedon scan over chunked sequence. The sequence is tiled into row-like chunks; the selective recurrence sweeps chunk 1 left-to-right, chunk 2 right-to-left, chunk 3 left-to-right, and so on, carrying the hidden state across the turn without resetting -- exactly as boustrophedon text continues seamlessly across reversed lines. Crucially, on reversed chunks the input-dependent parameters (B, C and the mirror of Labanotation's left/right-side symbols) are applied with a learned 'mirrored' parameterization so the model can represent direction-dependent dynamics rather than forcing symmetry. This gives each token bidirectional context (information from both the preceding and, via the serpentine turn, the locally following chunk) at the same O(N) cost and within a single causal-compatible kernel, by treating future-chunk reversal as additional within-state-pass context. New capability: cheap approximate bidirectionality for SSMs (useful for infilling, classification, and editing) without the quadratic cost of full bidirectional attention and without a second separate backward model.

constructs.merged_construct: Sonata-Form Context Window: exposition-development-recapitulation memory with thematic key transposition

parents.name: Agent Memory Below the Prompt (Persistent Q4 KV Cache)

constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Persistent quantized KV cache is an edge-inference memory trick; sonata form is a Classical-era large-scale tonal architecture (exposition of themes in conflicting keys, development through distant keys, recapitulation with tonal resolution); the monomyth is Campbell's universal departure-initiation-return narrative arc. Disk-resident attention state and 18th-century formal music share nothing.
constructs.mechanism: Structure an agent's persistent KV memory as a sonata: tag cached spans by role -- 'exposition' spans (the introduced task themes / key facts), 'development' spans (intermediate reasoning that fragments and transforms those themes), and 'recapitulation' spans (resolved conclusions). On reload, instead of restoring a flat cache, the system restores exposition and recapitulation themes at full Q4 fidelity but compresses development spans further, mirroring how sonata form returns themes while discarding developmental episode detail. Borrowing sonata's tonal transposition, theme spans carry a learned 'key' transform so a fact introduced in one context can be re-presented (transposed) into the current task's frame on recall rather than verbatim, and the monomyth's departure-return arc supplies the rule that long-horizon agent runs must explicitly re-present (recapitulate) the originating goal-theme near task close to guarantee return to the initiating objective. This cuts reload memory by prioritizing structurally load-bearing spans and combats long-run goal drift by enforcing thematic return. Implementable as a span-tagger plus role-conditioned quantization and a transposition adapter over the persisted cache.

constructs.merged_construct: Call-and-Response Speculative Verification: antiphonal draft-target dialogue with completion constraint
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: GRPO is a group-normalized RL objective for reasoning; call-and-response is an antiphonal musical/oral structure where a leader phrase is answered by a group phrase that completes or intensifies it; the Gricean cooperative principle governs informative, relevant, truthful contribution in dialogue. Reinforcement learning and African-American sacred song forms are unrelated.
constructs.mechanism: Borrow call-and-response dynamics to restructure GRPO sampling into a leader-chorus protocol. For each prompt the policy first emits a single short 'call' (a committed plan/claim stub), then samples the group of G full responses as 'responses' that must each answer the same call -- the group is conditioned on the shared call, so within-group advantage normalization compares completions of one structured invitation rather than G independent rollouts, sharpening the variance-reduced advantage signal. The Gricean maxims become a shaped reward: each response is scored for Quantity (sufficiently but not redundantly informative relative to the call), Relation (relevance to the call), and Quality (consistency/no contradiction with the call), with violations penalized; this turns vague preference reward into a decomposed, auditable signal that completes-or-intensifies the call the way an antiphonal answer must complete its leader phrase. New capability: more sample-efficient GRPO (shared-call grouping reduces advantage noise) plus an interpretable, maxim-based reward that discourages off-topic or padded reasoning, with the call/response split implementable as a two-stage decode within the existing rollout loop.

constructs.merged_construct: Zipf-Tempered Tokenizer: frequency-power-law merge schedule with grammaticalization drift
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Masked-language pretraining and its BPE-style vocabulary are NLP engineering; Zipf's law is a quantitative-linguistics power law balancing speaker/hearer effort; grammaticalization is the historical, unidirectional erosion of concrete words into abstract grammatical markers. The diachronic life-cycle of words and a frozen subword vocabulary are not connected in practice.
constructs.mechanism: Mirror two linguistic failure/aging modes inside the tokenizer and masking policy. First, Zipf failure: standard frequency-greedy merges over-allocate token budget to head n-grams and starve the long tail, hurting rare-token modeling. Impose a Zipf-target merge schedule that accepts a merge only if it moves the vocabulary's empirical rank-frequency curve toward the ideal 1/n power law (a divergence penalty between observed and Zipfian frequencies), deliberately preserving informative mid-frequency units and capping head dominance. Second, grammaticalization drift: mirror the unidirectional bleaching of frequent concrete forms into abstract markers by letting the most-frequent, most-predictable tokens 'grammaticalize' -- they are demoted to lightweight functional embeddings (low-rank, shared) and are masked far more aggressively during MLM pretraining (since, like grammatical morphemes, they are highly recoverable from context), reallocating prediction effort to contentful tokens. The masking rate per token is thus a function of its corpus predictability, reproducing the concrete-to-abstract gradient. New capability: a vocabulary and masking curriculum that improves rare-token and morphologically rich-language modeling and yields a compact functional-token subspace, both derived from explicit linguistic laws rather than pure frequency greed.

constructs.merged_construct: Koji-Schedule Curriculum Distillation
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Solid-state fungal enzymology (sequential extracellular amylase/protease secretion that pre-digests a substrate before a second microbe acts) has no contact with neural-network model compression; nobody crosses koji microbiology with teacher-student training.
constructs.mechanism: Koji works because A. oryzae first floods a grain substrate with amylases/proteases that hydrolyze starch and protein into simpler sugars and peptides, and only then does a second fermenting organism consume those pre-broken-down nutrients. Borrow this two-enzyme staged pre-digestion as a curriculum over distillation targets. Replace single-temperature soft-label distillation with a schedule in which the teacher emits a sequence of progressively 'hydrolyzed' targets: early epochs distill only the teacher's coarse macro-class marginals (high softmax temperature = starch broken to maltose), mid epochs distill cluster-level logits, and late epochs distill the full fine-grained logit distribution and attention maps. Each stage's loss is gated on by a 'maturation' detector that monitors when the student's KL to the current target has plateaued, exactly as koji is judged ready by enzyme saturation before the next ferment begins. A second 'protease' channel separately distills the teacher's representation geometry (pairwise feature similarities) on a slower clock than the 'amylase' logit channel. The new capability is a self-pacing distillation that gives small students the easy-to-absorb signal first and unlocks hard structured signal only once the prerequisite has been digested, improving low-capacity student convergence over fixed-temperature KD.

constructs.merged_construct: Malolactic Reward Conversion for RLHF
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Bacterial conversion of harsh dicarboxylic malic acid into softer monocarboxylic lactic acid (a secondary ferment that 'rounds' wine), and the over-oxidation hazard of acetification, are oenology; preference-optimization losses are alignment. The domains never meet.
constructs.mechanism: Malolactic fermentation does not add reward, it transforms an existing harsh signal (sharp malic acid) into a softer, more stable one (lactic acid), and crucially it must be stopped before acetic-acid spoilage (over-oxidation). Swap this substrate-conversion dynamic into preference optimization. Replace DPO's fixed log-ratio reward with a two-stage objective: stage one trains on raw, high-variance pairwise preferences (the 'malic' signal, sharp and noisy); stage two applies a learned monotone 'malolactic' transform that recalibrates the implicit reward, compressing extreme preference margins toward a smoother distribution while preserving ranking, reducing reward over-sharpness that causes policy collapse. The key borrowed rule is the spoilage cutoff: an 'acetification monitor' (a held-out KL or a secondary diversity metric) halts the conversion the moment the policy begins over-optimizing into degenerate, repetitive 'vinegar' outputs, freezing the reference at the last good cask. This yields preference training that deliberately softens its own reward landscape mid-run and self-arrests before over-optimization, distinct from static beta-weighted DPO.

constructs.merged_construct: Companion-Planting Mixture-of-Experts Router
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Allelochemical inhibition between neighboring crops and nitrogen-fixing rotation are agronomy/soil ecology; sparse expert routing in transformers is systems ML. No one designs MoE gates from intercropping chemistry.
constructs.mechanism: Companion planting exploits two control laws: allelopathy, where some plant pairs chemically suppress each other (mutual inhibition) while others mutually benefit, and rotation, where a nitrogen-fixing crop conditions the soil so a later nutrient-hungry crop thrives. Import both into MoE routing. Replace the standard load-balancing auxiliary loss with an 'allelopathy matrix' A_ij learned over expert pairs: experts that historically produce destructive interference when co-activated on the same token (measured by gradient conflict / output incoherence) accrue a negative co-activation bias, so the router avoids planting antagonistic experts together, while synergistic pairs get a positive companion bias. The 'rotation' law operates across the token sequence and across training phases: a 'nitrogen-fixer' expert specialized on cheap structural/syntactic features is preferentially routed before 'heavy-feeder' experts that depend on that conditioned representation, enforced by a temporal routing prior. The new capability is a router that learns which expert combinations poison versus enrich one another and schedules them like an intercropped field, improving expert specialization and reducing the redundant-expert collapse that plagues top-K gating.

constructs.merged_construct: Triple-Modular-Redundancy Verifier Voting for Test-Time Compute
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Hardware TMR (three independent modules feeding a majority voter to mask single-module faults in avionics/spacecraft) is fault-tolerant circuit design; test-time reasoning scaling is LLM inference. The fields share no literature.
constructs.mechanism: TMR masks a fault by running three independent modules and trusting the majority, with a voter that detects and outvotes the diverging unit. Transfer this structure to test-time compute but apply it at the reasoning-step granularity rather than the whole answer. Replace best-of-N (which only votes on final outputs) with three architecturally or seed-diverse reasoning channels run in lockstep step-by-step; at each reasoning checkpoint a lightweight 'voter' (a PRM or an exact-match over canonicalized intermediate states) compares the three partial solutions. When one channel diverges, it is rolled back and re-synchronized to the majority partial state before continuing, masking a single hallucinated step instead of discovering the error only at the end. The borrowed fault-tolerance rule of graceful degradation maps to a budget law: if two channels persistently disagree (no majority), the system escalates to a fourth channel or flags the problem as low-confidence rather than emitting a coin-flip answer. The new capability is per-step error masking and synchronized recovery, catching reasoning faults early and spending compute only where the redundant channels actually diverge, unlike independent best-of-N sampling.

constructs.merged_construct: Kimchi-Succession Self-Training Curriculum
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Microbial community succession (Leuconostoc dominating early then yielding to acid-tolerant Lactobacillus as pH drops, each microbe reshaping the niche for its successor) and thermophilic compost phase-handoff are food/soil microbiology; EMA self-distillation is self-supervised vision. Unconnected.
constructs.mechanism: Kimchi ripens through succession: low-acid-tolerant Leuconostoc bloom first and lower the pH, which then selects for and hands off to acid-tolerant Lactobacillus, with each population engineering the environment that determines its successor; composting similarly hands off from mesophiles to thermophiles by raising temperature. Borrow this niche-handoff dynamic to schedule the teacher in self-distillation. Replace DINO's single fixed-EMA teacher with a succession of teacher 'populations' that take over as the data environment acidifies: an early teacher is trained only on easy, high-agreement pseudo-labels (the Leuconostoc phase), and the very act of training lowers prediction entropy across the dataset, which then 'selects' a harder pseudo-label pool that activates a second, more acid-tolerant teacher specialized on the now-confident-but-subtle examples. Each teacher's EMA decay and centering temperature are tuned to its phase, and handoff is triggered when dataset-wide pseudo-label entropy crosses a pH-like threshold. The new capability is an automatically phased self-training schedule where the model's own growing confidence reshapes which examples drive learning next, avoiding the collapse and stagnation of a single static-temperature teacher.

constructs.merged_construct: Annealing-Schedule Quantization Recrystallization
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Metallurgical annealing (heat above recrystallization, let dislocations migrate and anneal out, then nucleate strain-free grains on slow cooling) and powder sintering by surface-energy-driven diffusion are materials processing; quantization-aware training is model compression. No shared playbook.
constructs.mechanism: Annealing relieves internal stress by raising temperature so atomic diffusion lets dislocations rearrange and new strain-free grains nucleate, then locking in the relaxed structure by controlled slow cooling; sintering fuses discrete particles by diffusion across boundaries below melting. Import this thermal control law into QAT to manage quantization stress. Replace the fixed straight-through-estimator schedule with an explicit 'temperature' that controls the softness of the fake-quantization rounding: early in training temperature is high, so the quantizer is a soft, nearly-continuous relaxation (dislocations free to move = weights free to migrate between bins without hard snapping), relieving the high gradient 'stress' that abrupt rounding induces. The temperature is then annealed down on a schedule, hardening the quantizer toward true integer levels so weights 'recrystallize' onto the discrete grid in low-stress configurations. A 'sintering' phase fuses adjacent weight clusters by adding a diffusion penalty that pulls nearby weights toward shared quantization centroids, reducing the number of distinct levels actually used. The new capability is a stress-relieved path to low-bit weights that reaches the integer grid through a soft-to-hard recrystallization, improving low-bit accuracy over constant-hardness QAT.

constructs.merged_construct: Fluidized-Bed Stochastic Batch Mixer
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Fluidization (upward gas flow suspending solid particles so a packed bed behaves like a turbulently mixed fluid with uniform temperature) and counter-flow heat exchange are chemical engineering unit operations; batch-statistic normalization is a neural layer. No overlap.
constructs.mechanism: A fluidized bed suspends solid particles in an upward flow so that, above the minimum fluidization velocity, the bed mixes vigorously and reaches near-uniform temperature and concentration regardless of where material entered; a heat exchanger uses counter-flow to equalize gradients efficiently. Borrow this active-suspension mixing to redesign how batch statistics homogenize features. Replace BatchNorm's static per-batch mean/variance with a 'fluidization velocity' hyperparameter that controls how strongly activations are mixed across the batch and across a buffered window of recent batches: at low velocity the layer behaves like a packed bed (per-sample, almost InstanceNorm), and as velocity rises, a stochastic exchange operator permutes and blends feature statistics across samples so no sample sits in a stagnant pocket, suppressing the dead-zone heterogeneity that causes BatchNorm to fail at small batch sizes. The counter-flow rule maps to a momentum buffer that flows running statistics opposite to the data stream, equalizing the statistic gradient between early and late batches. The new capability is a normalization layer with a tunable mixing intensity that maintains uniform feature distributions even with tiny or non-i.i.d. batches, where standard BatchNorm degrades.

constructs.merged_construct: Grafting Adapter Cambium-Union Transfer
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Horticultural grafting (aligning the meristematic cambium of scion and rootstock so callus bridges and vascular continuity form across the wound) and layering propagation are plant biology; low-rank parameter adaptation is PEFT. The disciplines are unrelated.
constructs.mechanism: A successful graft requires precise alignment of the thin cambium layers of scion and rootstock; only at that interface does callus form and vascular tissue reconnect, so the union is localized to a specific tissue layer, not the whole stem. Transfer this layer-alignment principle to adapter placement. Replace LoRA's heuristic 'insert rank-r matrices in all attention/MLP projections' with a 'cambium-matching' procedure that first locates, per layer, the narrow subspace where the donor task (scion) and base model (rootstock) representations are most compatible, measured by alignment of their activation principal directions, and grafts the low-rank update only there, aligning the adapter's A-matrix initialization to the shared cambium subspace rather than random Gaussian. The 'callus bridge' is an explicit warmup phase where the adapter is trained with a continuity loss that forces base and adapted activations to remain vascularly connected (bounded representational drift) until the union 'heals', after which the bridge regularizer is released. Layering contributes a variant: when no scion is available, a frozen sub-branch of the base model is wounded (its activations perturbed) to induce a new adapter to root in place. The new capability is graft-site-targeted, alignment-initialized adaptation that takes faster and resists rejection (catastrophic interference) compared to uniformly-placed random-init LoRA.

constructs.merged_construct: Phase-Locked-Loop Optimizer Synchronization
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: A phase-locked loop (phase detector + loop filter + VCO that drives a controlled oscillator to track a reference's phase) and the centrifugal flyball governor are classical control electronics/mechanics; adaptive-moment optimization is an ML training algorithm. Distinct fields.
constructs.mechanism: A PLL locks a local oscillator to a reference by detecting phase error and feeding it through a loop filter to steer the oscillator's frequency until phase-aligned; a centrifugal governor regulates speed by feeding back rotational state to throttle input. Import the PLL control law to govern the learning rate of Adam. Treat the optimizer's effective update frequency (how fast parameters oscillate, estimated from the sign-change rate / autocorrelation of recent gradients) as a VCO, and treat a target oscillation rate (set so updates neither thrash nor stall) as the reference phase. Replace the fixed or cosine learning-rate schedule with a phase detector that measures the lag between gradient direction changes and parameter updates, passing this error through a loop filter (a low-pass on the phase error) that continuously nudges the learning rate to lock the update dynamics onto the stable reference rhythm, damping the oscillatory thrash that fixed Adam exhibits near sharp minima. The governor adds a hard speed limit: if measured update 'rpm' exceeds a threshold, a flyball-style term throttles the global step size. The new capability is a self-synchronizing optimizer whose learning rate is a closed-loop control output locked to the loss landscape's local oscillation frequency, rather than an open-loop preset schedule.

constructs.merged_construct: Dovetail Interlock Tokenizer Merge
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: Dovetail and mortise-and-tenon joinery (trapezoidal pins/tails and shouldered tenons whose geometry mechanically interlocks two members so they resist pulling apart with no glue) are fine woodworking; grouped key-value sharing in attention is transformer architecture. No connection.
constructs.mechanism: A dovetail joins two boards by interlocking trapezoidal pins and tails whose widening geometry makes the joint stronger under tension the harder it is pulled; a mortise-and-tenon seats a shouldered tongue precisely into a matching socket so load transfers cleanly across the interface. Transfer this geometric interlock to how query heads bind to shared key-value heads in GQA. Replace GQA's uniform mean-pooled assignment of query heads to one KV head per group with a learned 'dovetail' coupling: each query head is shaped with a complementary projection (the pin) that fits a specifically carved KV subspace (the tail), and the binding strength is made load-adaptive so that under high attention demand (sharp, high-norm queries pulling hard) the interlock tightens, routing those queries to a more precisely matched KV head, while low-demand queries seat into a looser shared socket. The mortise-and-tenon shoulder maps to an alignment constraint that forces the query projection to seat flush against the KV key geometry, minimizing the representational gap introduced by KV sharing. The new capability is a tension-aware, geometry-matched query-to-KV binding that recovers more of full multi-head attention's fidelity at GQA's memory cost, instead of lossy uniform mean-pooling.

constructs.merged_construct: Integrated-Pest-Management Threshold Early-Stopping
constructs.cognitive_distance_note: IPM's economic-threshold rule (intervene with control only when monitored pest density reaches the point where damage cost equals control cost) and artificial selection are agricultural pest/animal management; stochastic regularization by unit-dropping is a neural training trick. The domains do not intersect.
constructs.mechanism: IPM rejects spraying on a fixed schedule; instead it monitors pest density continuously and applies an intervention only when the population crosses the economic threshold where prevented damage equals the cost of control, deliberately tolerating sub-threshold pests. Mirror this failure-triggered, cost-aware intervention in regularization, treating co-adapted/overfitting units as the 'pest' and dropout as the 'pesticide' that has its own cost (lost capacity, noisy gradients). Replace fixed-rate dropout with a monitored regime: a detector estimates per-layer 'infestation' (co-adaptation measured by feature correlation and the gap between train and validation loss), and the dropout rate for that layer is raised only when infestation crosses an economic threshold where the expected overfitting damage exceeds the capacity cost of dropping, otherwise dropout is held near zero so healthy capacity is not needlessly sprayed. Selective breeding contributes a complementary law: units that repeatedly survive high-dropout 'pressure' while remaining useful are preferentially retained and their initialization propagated (artificial selection over the population of units), gradually breeding a network of robust, non-co-adapted features. The new capability is a self-titrating, cost-aware regularizer that intervenes surgically where overfitting actually emerges, rather than applying a blanket dropout rate everywhere.
